lines: This Karaṅkiṇī goddess; Jvālinī hear now; jaw and forehead, hands spreading fingers clear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣā karaṅkiṇī devī jvālinīṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam hanurlalāṭagau hastau prasāryāṅgulitaḥ sphuṭau
